description: This file defines the GenericPdu class, which models a generic Protocol Data Unit (PDU) used in MMS messaging. It encapsulates header management and provides methods to access and modify specific PDU headers such as message type, MMS version, and sender information.

classes.name: GenericPdu
classes.description: A class representing a generic MMS Protocol Data Unit (PDU), providing accessors and mutators for common PDU headers.

methods.name: GenericPdu
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the PDU headers.

methods.name: GenericPdu
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PDU with specified headers.

methods.name: getPduHeaders
methods.description: Returns the PDU headers object associated with this PDU.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Retrieves the message type field from the PDU headers.

methods.name: setMessageType
methods.description: Sets the message type field in the PDU headers; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getMmsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the MMS version field from the PDU headers.

methods.name: setMmsVersion
methods.description: Sets the MMS version field in the PDU headers; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the 'From' address value from the PDU headers.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the 'From' address value in the PDU headers.
